annotations.title: Audit FAR Subpart 9.5 Organizational Conflicts of Interest (OCI) & Generate Mitigation Plan

description: Audit existing prime/subcontract awards (SETA, A&AS, IV&V, Systems Engineering, Cloud Architecture) against a target solicitation scope to detect Unequal Access to Information, Biased Ground Rules, and Impaired Objectivity under FAR Subpart 9.5 (FAR 9.505-1 through 9.505-4) and generate an OCI Risk Score (0-100), a 3-Pillar Case-Law Audit Matrix, an Organizational Firewall & NDA Control Matrix, and a ready-to-submit OCI Disclosure & Mitigation Plan volume. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive compliance and legal-engineering generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `new_solicitation_scope_and_oci_clauses` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters and `existing_contracts_and_corporate_relationships` accepts 20 to 35,000 characters). Use this tool when auditing FAR 9.5 / DFARS 252.209-7008 / 252.209-7009 Organizational Conflicts of Interest or drafting an OCI Mitigation Plan & Non-Disclosure Firewall; use `scan_far_dfars_clauses` instead for general Section I FAR/DFARS flow-down clause scanning, or `generate_teaming_strategy` to structure 13 CFR 125.6 Prime/Sub workshare splits.

existing_contracts_and_corporate_relatio.description: Current or recent Prime/Subcontract awards (SETA, A&AS, IV&V, Systems Engineering, Cloud/Cyber Operations), affiliate/parent corporate structure, and agency access held by the bidder or its teammates (20 to 35,000 characters).

new_solicitation_scope_and_oci_clauses.description: Target RFP/Task Order PWS/SOW scope, Section H/I/L Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) clauses (FAR 9.5, DFARS 252.209-7008/7009, agency OCI provisions), and evaluation roles (20 to 45,000 characters).

proposed_mitigation_posture.description: Preferred OCI mitigation posture: 'Firewall_and_Subcontractor_Carveout' (firewalled enclave + independent subcontractor evaluation carve-out), 'Divestiture_or_Recusal_Protocol' (formal recusal from conflicting task orders), 'Affirmative_No_OCI_Certification' (formal no-OCI representation), or 'Auto_Recommend' (default).

name: generate_oci_mitigation_plan

contracting_officer_disclosure_checklist.description: Pre-submission OCI disclosure & representation checklist items.

executive_oci_summary.description: Executive summary of the FAR Subpart 9.5 audit and mitigation strategy for the Contracting Officer.

firewall_and_compliance_controls.description: Physical, logical, personnel, NDA, and subcontractor carve-out controls.

oci_overall_risk_score.description: Quantitative FAR Subpart 9.5 OCI risk score from 0 (no OCI) to 100 (unmitigable OCI).

overall_oci_determination.description: Formal OCI determination (NO_OCI_DETECTED, MITIGABLE_VIA_FIREWALL_AND_RECUSAL, SUBCONTRACTOR_CARVEOUT_REQUIRED, HIGH_RISK_WAIVER_OR_DIVESTITURE).

ready_to_submit_oci_mitigation_plan_narr.description: Complete, paste-ready OCI Disclosure & Mitigation Plan volume in Markdown.

three_pillar_far_9_5_audit.description: 3-Pillar audit across Unequal Access to Information, Biased Ground Rules, and Impaired Objectivity with GAO/COFC precedents.

title: Audit FAR Subpart 9.5 Organizational Conflicts of Interest (OCI) & Generate Mitigation Plan
